verdict.rationale: Aider has no documented capability for always-on agents that run on schedules or autonomous triggers to maintain and fix software. Its `--message` scripting mode does one instruction and exits, so it is a one-off action, not a recurring schedule. `--watch-files` only responds to AI comments a human writes in the code, which is not autonomous maintenance. The 'navigator-mode' autonomy package is a community add-on rather than a first-party feature, and any scheduling would rely on user-side cron workarounds.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to maintain and fix my software autonomously
